interpretation: One 100,000-file timing pair; each variant independently verifies all 100,003 final files, original inode identities and equality with a fresh portable full scan.
The comparison gate requires matching accelerator, VM resources, guest kernel, SQLite, fixture shape and distinct executable hashes. Both use KVM with two vCPUs and 4 GiB RAM.

Apply plus first follow-up falls from 15.349 seconds to 11.908 seconds (22.4%). Apply itself grows from 7.179 to 11.892 seconds; the following mapping refresh falls from 8.170 seconds to 0.016 seconds and zero input-file opens.
These are single samples of initial apply and first follow-up, not statistical estimates or a claim of the same percentage gain at one million files.
The independent million-file run demonstrates zero destination reopening after initial apply and complete content/inode/oracle verification; its older comparison used different hosts.
